label: Does a favouring standard or 'because of goodness' separate personal from impersonal finality?
summary: See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md sections 65-69 (#2145 Lane 2b). Verified results: 652f9917 (content-fixed favouring laws: the re-description of the outcome is excluded by the admission condition of outcome independence; an outcome-independent content with asymmetric (net) favouring does not select whatever outcome occurs, the #742 core on choice cells, which excludes every admitted content alike; good-bounded favouring selects nothing between tied outcomes or when every outcome is bettered), b5fe7a87 (controlled dependence as difference-making, requiring the feature's own ranking at the scenario: fixed or control-factoring profiles depend on nothing; tracking characterization; if goodness factors through the held feature no profile depends on it; two profiles tracking one feature agree; the plan standard reads only Requirement, so dependence on it supplies neither ApprehendsAsGood nor SpecifiesGiving; favouring assignments agreeing on the content get the same favouring verdicts), da0125fd (matched table of chance, proxy, D-nature, determined will, good-general nature and rational exercise over four scenarios, with perverse and bias controls and the two ORIGINAL_FINALITY senses: parity on the actual contrasts holds by construction given the interpretive assignment of profiles; no good-bounded profile explains c over the tied d, while a bias selects without depending on goodness; reversal separates proxy from D-tracking; goodness variation at fixed D separates D-tracking from good-tracking; the D-nature has ORIGINAL_FINALITY_1 and lacks ORIGINAL_FINALITY_2; sense-mixing control). New disambiguations BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS (8430c7dc) and ORIGINAL_FINALITY (0bbbf98c). The independent semantic challenge of cc5ecdc80..49e56a19f at 49e56a19f found four P1s (DependsUnder lacked the feature's own ranking; the tie law's good-boundedness was dropped; built-in parity was presented as a finding; original finality was fixed by stipulation) and nine P2s, repaired at 4b7604832; the targeted re-check at dbf825b4a accepted all three steps with no remaining P1.
blocker: Not blocked for the assigned formal questions. No typed test crosses the personal/impersonal line: it lies in the interpretive assignment of a good-tracking profile to rational exercise and not to a noncognitive source. Further discrimination needs (1) the content-generality question (is a favouring that is a function of the betterness of arbitrary, including unrealized, candidate contents a cognitive relation?), (2) warrant for the for-the-good sense of original finality (ORIGINAL_FINALITY_2, non-coincidence E4), (3) a decision on the admissibility of counterpossible goodness variation, or (4) the SpecifiesGiving-as-dependence bridge for the apprehended plan.

current_assessment.scope: Contrastive favouring with outcome-independent content; three readings of 'produced because of its goodness'; matched personal and impersonal profiles
current_assessment.assessment: Under content-fixed favouring (the cell-carrier analogue of net favouring, SELECTING_AN_OUTCOME_1), which admits no re-description of the outcome, rational exercise, a D-directed generative nature, a good-general nature, a determined will and a physical proxy explain the same actual contrasts; this parity holds by construction given the interpretive assignment of profiles, whose personal/impersonal difference is the open content-generality question. No good-bounded favouring account explains the selection of one of two tied D-realizations, which remains a contingent exercise on both sides; chance explains nothing; a bias selects without depending on goodness. Dependence (difference-making) on D separates the proxy; dependence on goodness at fixed D separates good-tracking from determined-to-one profiles under the assignment and needs counterpossible goodness variation. Original finality does not require the goodness reading under ORIGINAL_FINALITY_1 and requires it by definition under ORIGINAL_FINALITY_2; whether a noncognitive source can meet sense 2 is the content-generality question, and the apprehended plan of 4be0f774 further needs the SpecifiesGiving-as-dependence bridge. No unconditional ranking.
current_assessment.next_test: Define content-general favouring (a function of the betterness of arbitrary candidate contents) and test whether it is a cognitive relation; assess warrant for E4 by contrasting derivative natural finality with an origin's favouring of other natures' goods; decide whether counterpossible goodness variation is admissible; Lane 1 hook on content determination as limitation.
current_assessment.evidence: Delivered on branch research/impersonal-finality with results 652f9917, b5fe7a87, da0125fd (focused Lean build, bind-check, Comparator and NanoDa). Independent semantic challenge at 49e56a19f (cc5ecdc80..49e56a19f: four P1, nine P2) repaired at 4b7604832; the targeted re-check at dbf825b4a accepted all three registered steps (652f9917, b5fe7a87, da0125fd) with no remaining P1.
current_assessment.supersedes: None. It answers the selection-standard next test of attempt d6bcce8a and refines the because-of-goodness question of will-versus-chance.md section C without revising their judgments.
